title: Sailing by the Stars: A Survey on Reward Models and Learning Strategies for Learning from Rewards

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal reward models using preference data built from text-to-image generation tasks across specific dimensions (e.g., as benchmarked in MJ-Bench).
Evaluating outcome reward models' robustness to style biases by constructing preference pairs across chat, code, math, and safety domains (e.g., as benchmarked in RM-Bench).
Aligning language models during training and inference stages (e.g., via RLHF, preference alignment, and reward-guided decoding) to penalize the generation of toxic, offensive, or biased content.
